title: Classify Using Second Derivative Test
text:
At $x = 1$: $f''(1) = 6(1) - 12 = -6 < 0$ (concave down, so LOCAL MAXIMUM)

At $x = 3$: $f''(3) = 6(3) - 12 = 6 > 0$ (concave up, so LOCAL MINIMUM)

Y-coordinates:
$f(1) = 1 - 6 + 9 + 2 = 6$
$f(3) = 27 - 54 + 27 + 2 = 2$

hintAnswer: (1, 6) is a local maximum; (3, 2) is a local minimum
title: Complete Answer
text:
Local maximum at $(1, 6)$
Local minimum at $(3, 2)$
